text: Lenovo Group Limited completed its purchase of Motorola Mobility from Google on 30 October 2014, making Motorola Mobility a wholly owned Lenovo subsidiary.

source.name: Lenovo StoryHub: Lenovo Completes Acquisition of Motorola Mobility from Google
source.quote: announced today that Lenovo’s acquisition of Motorola Mobility from Google is complete.

additionalSources.name: GeekWire (Blair Hanley Frank): Lenovo closes acquisition of Motorola Mobility
additionalSources.quote: Motorola’s brands will continue, and the company will operate as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Lenovo.
